title: Vulnerability management: scanning, prioritising and deadlines

videos.script: Every week, new flaws are published in software you run. There are more of them than anybody can fix. {{cycle}} Vulnerability management is the routine that keeps up anyway. Find out what is installed. Match it against what is known. Decide what comes first. Set a date. Check that it was done. {{compare}} You will write the comparison yourself, in a few lines. It is what every scanner does underneath. {{score}} Then the severity score, worked out by hand, and what it cannot tell you. {{priority}} A flaw that somebody is exploiting today beats a higher score that nobody is using. {{deadline}} And a finding with no date waits forever, so every finding gets one.
